description: 1932 is the Year of the Water Monkey in the Chinese zodiac, from February 6, 1932 to January 25, 1933. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 1932 is the Year of the Water Monkey, a Yang year. It began at Lunar New Year on February 6, 1932 and ended on January 25, 1933, so people born in 1932 before Feb 6 belong to the Metal Goat year.

sections.heading: When the 1932 Water Monkey year starts and ends
paragraphs: The 1932 Water Monkey year began at Lunar New Year on February 6, 1932 and lasted until January 25, 1933, the day before the next new year. Anyone born between January 1 and Feb 6 1932 therefore belongs to the Metal Goat year that started in 1931, while someone born in early 1933, up to Jan 25, is still a Water Monkey. The Chinese calendar is lunisolar, which is why the start date moves between January 21 and February 20 instead of staying on January 1. The same Water Monkey combination also falls in 1992, sixty years apart, because five elements and twelve animals realign only once in each sixty-year cycle. Lunar New Year 1932 fell on a Saturday, while the Western Sun was in Aquarius.

sections.heading: Water Monkey personality
paragraphs: Water Monkey years are associated with perceptive, diplomatic and adaptable people. The Monkey's Metal generates Water, so its cleverness is traditionally said to become subtle and intuitive rather than showy. People born then are often skilled communicators and negotiators who read situations quickly. The usual caution is scattered energy and secrecy, which clear priorities and open conversation help to balance.

Water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication. Descriptions associate it with wisdom, empathy and the ability to find a way around obstacles rather than through them. Water-year people are often portrayed as perceptive listeners, diplomatic and quietly persuasive, able to sense the mood of a room before anyone speaks. The element is linked with reflection and with the unseen, so it adds an inward, thoughtful layer. Its shadow, in most readings, is drift: indecision, secrecy, and a tendency to take on the shape of whoever is nearby.

sections.heading: 1932 in numerology and the twelve-year cycle
paragraphs: In numerology the year's digits come to 6, linked with home, care and responsibility, so a 6 year is read as one centred on family and commitments. The digits of 1932 add up to 15, which reduces to 6. In the twelve-year cycle the Monkey is the ninth animal, earthly branch Shen, with Metal as its fixed element and Yang polarity. The year element is Water, and in the five-element cycles metal generates Water. The year before was the Metal Goat and the year after is the Water Rooster.

In the traditional sexagenary count the year is called Ren-Shen: Ren is the Water heavenly stem and Shen is the Monkey's earthly branch. Stems and branches alternate between yang and yin together, which is why yang stems only ever meet yang animals.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 1932?
faq.answer: 1932 is the Year of the Water Monkey. It started on February 6, 1932 and ended on January 25, 1933.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 1932?
faq.answer: Check the date against Feb 6. Born before February 6, 1932, you are a Metal Goat; born on or after it, you are a Water Monkey.

faq.question: What element is 1932 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yang year. The Monkey's own fixed element is Metal; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 1932?
faq.answer: Ren-Shen. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Monkey year?
faq.answer: 1992, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1992.
